text:
Sorry about your string of pearls. Yes, there's likely something we can do.

**Plant Care Guarantee:** Mushy at the base counts as stem or root rot, which is covered as significant decline. You're at about 5 weeks (roughly 35 days), so you're past the standard 30-day window. As a Leafy Plus member, though, you get **90 days** from delivery, as long as your membership was active when you ordered the plant. Since you've been a member since last year, that should be the case.

**How to claim:**
1. Go to "My Orders" and start a Plant Care claim for the string of pearls.
2. Upload at least **two photos**: the whole plant and a close-up of the mushy base.
3. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**. You don't need to send the plant back.

**If approved:** you get **one free replacement** of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock. The replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee (90 days with Plus, if your membership is still active).

**One caveat:** the guarantee applies to decline "despite reasonable care." Overwatering isn't listed as an exclusion, but the specialist makes the final call, so I can't promise approval. It's worth mentioning in the claim that a neighbour watered it while you were away.

**Care advice:** The specialists can also tell you whether anything can be saved. Their chat is 9am-5pm Mon-Fri, or you can email help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day). In the meantime, only water when the top inch of soil is dry.
